items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: Because sometimes, you know after Martin and Malcolm, you get all these opportunist people

ctx.x: Because sometimes, you know after Martin and Malcolm, you get all these opportunist people and you know it just seems like that’s all there is you know. They don’t really
want to save the community, they want to be known for who they are. And they want to make themselves a leader. Most of the time a good leader just comes out of the people.
